new_gap: E605 is materially extended with platform CI #60616/#60629/#60642/#60661: a native OHOS worker may have only GDummyTlsBackend; a loopback test can still race when a raw server thread connects immediately to a fixed port; and a complete Meson-test runtime closure does not imply that Conan test_package can resolve its component-backed transitive SONAMEs. CI #60661 printed json-glib's directory in the explicit long path yet failed identically, so the safe reusable repair materializes a tested-package-first, alias-resolved, conflict-checked closure into one loader-first directory and self-signs critical copied roots at their final path. E6339 adds the distinct override-only versus direct force requirement boundary. E6341 reuses E502's established worker policy that LD_PRELOAD is rejected while exec-time DT_NEEDED is accepted, and adds the non-duplicate Meson mechanism: default --as-needed removes runtime roots that are present only transitively, so each test ELF must regain direct DT_NEEDED entries through a tightly scoped no-as-needed state; Windows-hosted OHOS clang wrappers require separate path arguments, native workers require project link arguments after compiler detection so the unsigned compiler-runnability probe remains clean, and copied roots must be freshly self-signed at each final task-private loader path.
